verses.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?

segments.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains:
From whence shall my help come?

verses.text: My help cometh from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

segments.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved:
He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

verses.text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.
Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.

segments.text: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.

segments.text: The sun shall not smite thee by day,

verses.text: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.

segments.text: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil;

verses.text: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.

segments.text: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in
From this time forth and for evermore.
